Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and…
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.

people.name: Cherith
people.line: Brook where Elijah hid during drought

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word; for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
translations.bsb: So Elijah did what the LORD had told him, and he went and lived by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
translations.kjv: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
translations.asv: So he went and did according unto the word of Jehovah; for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
